name: Approvals
description: Outbox: every outbound draft from every component, awaiting human approval
technicalDescription: The outbox of component 04 (פניות): every draft any component writes (reply to customer, detail request, logistics request, price approval request, monthly open-debts batch, insurance). Each row carries referenceCode CIM-<id> (appended to the subject), the writing component and reply tracking. Approving moves it to אושר – לא נשלח; nothing is ever sent yet.

columns.name: customerCode
columns.description: Priority customer code (text link to Customers)

columns.name: customerName
columns.description: Customer display name (denormalised)

columns.name: kind
columns.description: Draft kind

columns.name: recipientName
columns.description: Recipient name

columns.name: recipientContact
columns.description: Recipient email/phone

columns.name: subject
columns.description: Subject

columns.name: body
columns.description: Body (long text)

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Why the agent proposes this (long text)

columns.name: status
columns.description: Approval status

columns.name: draftedBy
columns.description: Drafted by

columns.name: draftedAt
columns.description: Drafted at

columns.name: decidedBy
columns.description: Decided by

columns.name: decidedAt
columns.description: Decided at

columns.name: decisionNote
columns.description: Decision note

columns.name: relatedTable
columns.description: Table of the record this draft belongs to (e.g. Disputes, MatchProposals, InboundEmails)

columns.name: relatedId
columns.description: Id of the related record, as text

columns.name: fromMailbox
columns.description: Bookkeeper mailbox the reply would come from

columns.name: attachmentUrls
columns.description: Attachment links (e.g. statement PDF), one per line

columns.name: batchId
columns.description: Batch id when the draft is part of a batch (open-debts batch, certain-match batch)

columns.name: inboundEmailId
columns.description: Inbound email this draft answers (text link to InboundEmails.messageId)

columns.name: isTestFixture
columns.description: True for marked test data; DeleteTestFixtures removes these rows. Writers always set it (no defaults).

columns.name: referenceCode
columns.description: Reference CIM-<id> appended to the subject of every outbound message; an inbound reply carrying it is linked back to this row

columns.name: threadId
columns.description: Provider thread id of the sent message (empty until real sending exists) or of the inbound mail it answers

columns.name: component
columns.description: Which component wrote this draft

columns.name: mailboxId
columns.description: Mailboxes.id the message would be sent from (text link)

columns.name: lastReplyEmailId
columns.description: InboundEmails.id of the latest reply linked to this message

columns.name: lastReplyAt
columns.description: When the latest reply arrived

columns.name: replyCount
columns.description: How many replies were linked to this message
